Coram : DEEPAK GUPTA, ANIRUDDHA BOSE
Child and Family Welfare – Child Custody – Parents in two different continents – In 2016, couple got married in India – Appellant-wife accompanied the husband, working in USA – A daughter was born in 2017 – Relationship of the couple got strained – and Domestic Relations District Court– Consent order passed inter alia making provision for shared parenting – Before the next date fixed in the Norfolk Court, the appellant along with the child came to India– Husband filed motion for emergency relief before the said Court
Decision Date : 20-01-2020 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 127/2020 | Bench : 2 Judges
